reviews.text: Great experience with LC Marshall and Sons. Very professional, reliable, and easy to communicate with. If you’re looking for a company connected to Charlottesville landscaping, I definitely recommend them. The team clearly cares about doing things the right way.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.text: This was an excellent choice to make for our lawn care needs, I’m so glad we chose this company. Everyone was freindly, and very helpful with answering any questions that we had. They did an excellent job with our entire. landscaping project from the beginning till the end. They made sure everything was as we wanted it. They did an excellent job and our yard is beautiful now. I will recommend this company to all of my friends and family and anyone that is needing this type of service.

reviews.author: A Faye
reviews.text: I referred a family member to this company. At first she was hesitant but then I took her to my house to see the work and we were on the phone setting up an appointment a hour later. She ended up getting more done than expected but they gave her such a good price she couldn’t help herself. Great company Thank you from my Aunt Sherry and myself.

reviews.author: whitney phelps
reviews.text: Charlottesville Landscaping did a wonderful job on my lawn. Straight,clean lines and great neat mulching was done. Very satisfied customer and would recommend any day to anyone.

reviews.author: WipeMeDownVA De'tails
reviews.text: Clearly Charlottesville's best! The landscaping team was professional, friendly, and incredibly hardworking from start to finish. They showed up on time, listened carefully to what I wanted, and turned my yard into something better than I imagined. The attention to detail was impressive, and everything was left clean and neat when they finished. I’ve already gotten compliments from neighbors and would 100% recommend this company to anyone looking for high-quality landscaping.

reviews.author: Prime Time
reviews.text: I went with the 1st landscaping company I contacted in Charlottesville and WOW, what a difference! They showed up on time, worked fast, and my lawn looks amazing now. It’s like they turned my backyard into a park. I’m pretty sure the grass is now greener than my neighbor’s. Would definitely recommend them to anyone looking to upgrade their yard!"

reviews.author: Ashley Doles
reviews.text: What a wonderful company. Beautiful work, great genuine professional team. I had a landscaping project done in Charlottesville they did so great they even completed the project before the dead line with complete accuracy.I will be calling them back for all other projects I have. If you need landscaping this is the company for you.

reviews.author: Isaura Garcia
reviews.text: These men that came to my house to edge my flower beds, mulch them and trim my brushes were so respectful, proactive and did amazing job, I will definitely be using Charlottesville Landscaping again next month!

reviews.author: Drake Indigo Transport
reviews.text: Thank you Lc Marshall and Son for being a great company with an awesome team. You all did a great job on my landscaping project for my mother and it looks great she loves her new smooth walkway helps a lot with her walker and her beautiful garden (it was a little rough) now it looks great> Thank you

reviews.author: Jay Hampton
reviews.text: Gifting a single star since they show up 1/2 the time. HOA/Community has been utilizing services this year for all lawns and common area. Worst choice ever. Don't provide contractual service at all - completely ignore what they have promised. Use very large mowers in tight areas with open gates spewing clippings, rock, sticks everywhere. Trucks leak oil and fluids on streets. Common areas and individual lawns in poor condition - awful. LC stands for Last Choice - HOA Boards beware. Low price = partial services done poorly if done at all. Owner does not monitor work or lack there of.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: This is a great landscaping company. Very respectful,reliable,responsible. Great communication and time management. My walkway is finally a walkway not just a way because you couldn't walk on it.

reviews.author: Isaura Garcia
reviews.text: Charlottesville Landscaping did an amazing job cutting my 1.5 acres of land , the line looked beautiful and the clean up was remarkable

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: Great company love them very accurate helpful polite organized if you need landscaping this is the company you need. Call them you won’t regret it

reviews.author: Walter Farmer
reviews.text: In the Charlottesville area, this is by far the best landscaping company I've used. Guys were on time, very polite, and the work was very high quality.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Amazing,Amazing,Amazing this is a wonderful company that did my landscaping project in Charlottesville and I love the finished result. Thank you all so much.Keep being great

reviews.author: Wes Robertson
reviews.text: Needed a complete overhaul and couldn't be happier. Professional, creative, and within our budget. Will use again for all our landscaping needs!

reviews.author: chris constant
reviews.text: I have lived at at my current address for just over a year and LC Marshall is the company contracted by our HOA. This company has shown repeatedly that their employees are not properly trained in how to use their equipment nor how to properly landscape. Even after several complaints through our HOA and directly to the employees providing the service, they still utilize weedeaters to cut larger areas of grass that are easily accessible with a walk behind push mower. As a result, the grass is cut so short that it dies. When it is time for mulching of beds, they repeatedly apply too much mulch around trees and in beds which results in mold growth and wasted mulch; the later resulting in higher cost of service.

reviews.author: Skye
reviews.text: Luke Marshall with Marshall and Sons is FANTASTIC! He and his crew are professional, hard working, and dedicated to customer satisfaction. I highly recommend them for routine maintenance as well as amazingly talented hardscaping.
